lines.t: Yeah, I feel the bass shake the floor tonight
But You’re closer than the beat running through my life
Speakers up, lights low, crowd is jumping high
Every color in the room painting up the sky
I was only here for noise, just to feel alive
Then Your presence hit my heart, opened up my eyes
All the drops and the synths, they can move my feet
But Your whisper in my soul cuts a deeper beat
When the kick drum hits, I remember this
Nothing in this world feels close to this
When the volume rises, I still hear Your voice
Quiet in the middle of the endless noise
Every moment with You feels so clear
You’re the rhythm underneath it all
You’re closer than the beat in my chest
Louder than the sound of the rest
YahuShua, You’re the pulse of my life
Holding every moment in Your light
When the music fades, You don’t leave
You’re the song that never repeats
Every breath, every step, I believe
You’re closer, closer than the beat
After show, streets empty, neon slowly dies
Friends are scrolling on their phones, looking for a high
But I’m walking with a peace that they can’t explain
‘Cause Your Spirit’s in my heart like a gentle flame
Every echo of the night slowly slips away
But Your mercy in my veins never fades to gray
I don’t need the stage just to feel Your fire
You’re the reason that my heart beats higher
When the silence settles after every song
You remind me I’ve been Yours all along
Every quiet moment with You
You’re the rhythm I can’t lose
You’re closer than the beat in my chest

You’re the song that never repeats

If the bass drops out, You remain
Steady love that never changes
Hands up, I surrender all
You’re the One who holds my heart
From the first note to the last
You’re the rhythm that will never pass
You’re closer than the beat in my chest
